title: Bram and the Locker
author: Marguerite Halloran
blurb: Xanthe Vasquez, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
